text:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's OOMs — want a tight plan for ownership and short timelines. Root signals: KV residency climbed steadily, eviction didn't kick for ~30m on several shards, GC spikes ~10s then thrashes.
jon: I can take eviction tuning + canary. I'll reproduce under the nightly stress profile and try smaller shard caps first.
ali: I'll own the profiling side — heap + allocator snapshots and slab/residency histograms. Plan: pprof heap + runtime/alloc traces, then diff before/after evict.
sophia: I'll handle rollout and fallback gates (canary->gradual->abort). Suggest auto-fallback if eviction rate < 50% for 10m or node residency > 85%.
maya: Actions (short):
- ali: collect pprof snapshots and allocator dumps on staging by EOD Wed.
- jon: implement eviction threshold canary on a 10% subset by Fri.
- sophia: rollout/fallback policy + dashboard alert by Thu.
- maya: draft GC/arena flags PR and perf test plan by Wed.
jon: Quick repro command I used: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=3h | grep -i oom` and a smoke check to track eviction counters: `curl localhost:9090/metrics | grep eviction_count`
ali: Early profiling note: saw repeated small allocations pinned in arena 3; saving /tmp/pprof_heap_*.pb.gz now. Will attach the tar in the ticket.
maya: +1 on artifacts. Put everything in PM-1234 (postmortem follow-up) so we track histogram diffs.
sophia: Dashboard thresholds to create: `resident_percent > 80` for 5m (warning), `resident_percent > 90` for 2m (critical). Also a regression alert if OOM count spikes > 3/day.
jon: Canary plan details: spin 50 nodes with eviction threshold 0.6 (was 0.75), monitor tail latency and error rate for 2 hours, rollback on >2% error delta or any OOM. I'll add a deploy-bot job that posts status.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: jobs/evict-canary-4227, reporting to #eng-runtime. Will post progress every 15m.
ali: For GC tuning, propose testing `GOGC=80` and `GOMEMLIMIT` knob (for native allocator) on staging. Will include p95/p99 latency and resident snapshots in the runbook.
maya: Timeline summary: snapshots (ali) Wed EOD, GC PR (maya) Wed EOD, rollout policy (sophia) Thu, eviction canary (jon) Fri. Sync Tuesday 10a for results and next steps.
jon: I'll open a short runbook with rollback commands and the quick `kubectl` checks.
sophia: tagging @oncall for visibility; also add ops runbook entries for manual eviction trigger.
ali: If I see arena fragmentation > 30% in snapshots we'll consider slab GC enable flag and schedule a deeper GC experiment.
maya: Good. If replication shows same pattern, we may need to add per-shard soft-limits. For now we focus on profiling + safer eviction.
jon: acked. I'll post the canary status after the first 15m run.
sophia: thanks all — marking owners in PM-1234 and listing follow-ups on the retro board. :thumbsup:
maya: Closing here until we have artifacts. Ping this thread when uploads are ready. :eyes:
